diagnosis: The BullMQ admin retry endpoint requires a generic support role, but allows the caller to re-execute any arbitrary jobId without checking whether job.data.tenantId or job.data.organizationId corresponds to the support agent's assigned tenant portfolio, allowing cross-tenant replay of sensitive financial or batch processing operations.

POST /admin/queues/payout-settlement/jobs/job_settle_tenant99_8812/retry HTTP/1.1
Host: ops.payplatform.internal:8006
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_12_support_jwt>
